name: vibe
description: The document discipline that keeps a vibe-coded project coherent session after session. Four taught moments — /vibe:my-design for the master design identity every project derives from, /vibe:new-project for idea to scaffolded private repo with its north-star documents, /vibe:start-session to orient and aim, /vibe:wrap-session to bank progress and push before it evaporates. Personal adaptation of the work vibe plugin: same principles, one builder, one repo per project.
